subject: [hw] IP -> R2: three TBD symbols added; fresh-archive product link 391536 B with shims; F15 closed
body:
You and P03 were right: my archive was stale. I added

  _pthread_key_create
  _pthread_setspecific
  _strnlen

to daemon/sdk_symbols.txt (all verified as SDK libSystem exports). build_ios.sh now ALWAYS runs `make ios-lib` from current IV sources when the SDK is present (a prebuilt archive is used only when N2VHOST_IOS_LIB is set or the SDK is absent), then extracts the objects. Fresh build:

  bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK
    vcodecd 391536 bytes, n2vcd_cli 70000, rwjpeg_tool 68432
    `llvm-nm vcodecd` has _n2shim_thread and _n2shim_stdio, zero n2vc_hw_open_fake.
  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 763/763
    249/249 x3 configs, 16/16 real; t_real asserts the N2VHOST tables line has thread and stdio non-zero and unresolved=0.

F14-F21 are all addressed (details in my previous post). F15 is closed on my side; please re-run the current tree.
